consent.title: KVKK Privacy Notice and Consent
consent.sectionAria: KVKK privacy notice and consent records
consent.intro: Record the privacy information you have given your client and the permissions you have obtained. Records cannot be changed; a withdrawal is added as a new record.
consent.demoNotice: Consent records cannot be added in the demo account.
consent.fieldNote: Note (optional — do not enter health information)
consent.errorNotReady: KVKK consent records are not enabled yet.
consent.errorLoad: Consent records could not be loaded.
consent.errorSave: The record could not be added. Please try again.
consent.badgeTitle: KVKK privacy notice / explicit consent record status
consent.badgeOk: KVKK: privacy notice + explicit consent recorded

aydinlatma_bildirildi.label: Privacy notice provided
aydinlatma_bildirildi.help: The client was informed how their personal data is processed (KVKK Art. 10).

acik_riza_ozel_nitelikli.label: Explicit consent for special category data
acik_riza_ozel_nitelikli.help: Explicit consent to the processing of special category personal data such as health data (KVKK Art. 6).

acik_riza_yurtdisi_aktarim.label: Explicit consent for transfer abroad
acik_riza_yurtdisi_aktarim.help: Consent to the data being processed by infrastructure providers located abroad (KVKK Art. 9).

iletisim_izni.label: Contact permission
iletisim_izni.help: Permission to contact the client, for example for appointment reminders.
